sources.authors: John T. S. Irvine, Derek C. Sinclair, Anthony R. West
sources.title: Electroceramics: Characterization by Impedance Spectroscopy

records.claim_ko: 세라믹 시료의 각 영역은 보통 병렬로 놓인 저항과 커패시턴스로 나타내며, 그 이완시간은 τ = RC 이다 (식 1).
records.claim: Each region of a ceramic sample is represented by a resistance and a capacitance, usually in parallel, whose relaxation time is tau = RC (Eq. 1).
records.conditions: Ideal parallel RC element; the paper uses no constant-phase elements. Measurements span 'typically 10^-2 to 10^7 Hz' (pp. 132-133).

records.claim_ko: 임피던스 스펙트럼의 최대 손실 주파수에서 ω_max·R·C = 1 (식 2) 이 성립하며, 이 관계 때문에 RC 요소들을 주파수 영역에서 분리할 수 있다.
records.claim: At the frequency of maximum loss in the impedance spectrum, omega_max*R*C = 1 (Eq. 2), which is what makes RC elements separable in the frequency domain.
records.conditions: Ideal parallel RC; omega_max is the top of the Z'' vs Z' semicircle.

records.claim_ko: R 은 Z′ 축 교점에서 읽고, C 는 각 반원 꼭대기의 주파수에 식 2 를 적용해 구한다.
records.claim: R values are read from the arc intercepts on the Z' axis and C values by applying Eq. 2 to the frequency at the maximum of each semicircle.
records.math: R = difference of the semicircle's Z' intercepts;  C = 1/(omega_max * R)
records.conditions: Needs the apex and both intercepts of the arc inside the measured window (see ISW1990.bulk-arc-off-scale).

records.claim_ko: 논문은 Z* = Z′ − jZ″ (j = √−1, ω = 2πf) 로 두고 Z″ 대 Z′ 를 그리므로, 용량성 응답에서 Z″ 가 양수다.
records.claim: The paper plots Z'' against Z' with Z* = Z' - jZ'' (j = sqrt(-1), omega = 2*pi*f), so its Z'' is positive for a capacitive response.
records.math: Z* = Z' - j*Z''  =>  paper's Z'' = -Im(Z) = -z_im in our physics convention
records.conditions: Applies to every Z'' and M'' statement in the paper (Z''max = R/2, M* = j*omega*C0*Z*).

records.claim_ko: R 과 C 를 구한 뒤, 각 RC 요소를 시료의 어느 영역에 대응시킬지는 커패시턴스의 크기(표 1)로 정한다.
records.claim: Once R and C are extracted, the RC elements are assigned to regions of the sample on the basis of the magnitudes of their capacitances (Table 1).
records.conditions: Magnitude-based and hedged: Table 1 is a 'possible interpretation' and the distinction is 'usually fairly straightforward' except with ferroelectrics (p. 134; ISW1990.ferroelectric-overlap-caveat). The paper also says the effects are 'characterized by their relative capacitance values' (p. 134).
records.quote: The assignment is based on the magnitudes of the capacitances (Table 1).

records.claim_ko: 면적 A, 간격 l, 유전율 ε′ 인 평행판 축전기의 커패시턴스는 C = ε′·e₀·A/l (식 3) 이고 e₀ = 8.854 × 10⁻¹⁴ F cm⁻¹ 이다.
records.claim: For a parallel-plate capacitor of area A, plate separation l and permittivity eps', C = eps'*e0*A/l (Eq. 3), with e0 = 8.854 x 10^-14 F cm^-1.
records.math: C = eps_r * e0 * A / l,  e0 = 8.854e-14 F/cm   =>   eps_r = (C * l/A) / e0
records.conditions: eps' is the relative permittivity (dimensionless). Eq. 3 is also the basis of the brickwork relation (Eq. 4) and of C0 = e0*A/l in Eq. 5.

records.claim_ko: 셀 상수 l/A = 1 cm⁻¹ 과 전형적 유전율 ~10 이면 커패시턴스는 ~1 × 10⁻¹² F 이고, 논문은 이것을 시료의 전형적인 벌크 커패시턴스로 본다.
records.claim: For a unit cell constant (l/A = 1 cm^-1) and a typical permittivity of ~10, a capacitance of ~1 x 10^-12 F is expected, which the paper takes as the typical bulk capacitance of a sample.
records.math: C = eps_r*e0*(A/l) = 10 * 8.854e-14 F/cm * 1 cm = 8.9e-13 F, i.e. ~1e-12 F (arithmetic ours)

values.label: bulk
values.note: for l/A = 1 cm^-1 and eps_r ~ 10; equivalently C*l/A ~ 1e-12 F/cm

records.conditions: This is the only sentence in the paper that states a cell constant, and it is attached to the bulk estimate, not to Table 1 as a whole. Non-ferroelectric material.
records.quote: unit cell constant (i.e. l/A = 1 cm⁻¹) and a typical permittivity of ~10, a capacitance value of ~1 × 10⁻¹² F is expected

records.claim_ko: 표 1 은 커패시턴스(F)와 그 가능한 해석을 나열한다: 10⁻¹² bulk, 10⁻¹¹ minor, second phase, 10⁻¹¹–10⁻⁸ grain boundary, 10⁻¹⁰–10⁻⁹ bulk ferroelectric, 10⁻⁹–10⁻⁷ surface layer, 10⁻⁷–10⁻⁵ sample-electrode interface, 10⁻⁴ electrochemical reactions.
records.claim: Table 1 lists capacitances in F with their possible interpretation: 10^-12 bulk; 10^-11 minor, second phase; 10^-11-10^-8 grain boundary; 10^-10-10^-9 bulk ferroelectric; 10^-9-10^-7 surface layer; 10^-7-10^-5 sample-electrode interface; 10^-4 electrochemical reactions.
records.conditions: Column header 'Capacitance [F]': plain farads. Neither caption nor table states a cell constant, an electrode area or any normalisation. Three rows are single order-of-magnitude values, not ranges. Rows overlap (grain boundary spans the whole bulk-ferroelectric row and the lowest decade of the surface-layer row) and leave a gap between 10^-5 and 10^-4 F. Written for ceramics/glasses with metal electrodes.
records.quote: Table 1. Capacitance values and their possible interpretation.

records.claim_ko: Ca₁₂Al₁₄O₃₃ (312 °C) 의 두 아크는 ~1 × 10⁻¹² F·0.45 MΩ (벌크) 와 4 × 10⁻⁹ F·1.15 MΩ (입계) 이며, 벌크·입계 병렬 RC 두 개를 직렬로 이은 회로로 해석한다.
records.claim: For Ca12Al14O33 (312 degC) the two arcs give ~1 x 10^-12 F with 0.45 MOhm (bulk) and 4 x 10^-9 F with 1.15 MOhm (grain boundary), interpreted with bulk and grain-boundary parallel RC elements in series.
records.where: Sect. 2.1 text; Fig. 1a with its circuit on p. 134
records.math: (Rb||Cb)-(Rgb||Cgb):  Rb = 0.45 MOhm, Cb ~ 1e-12 F;  Rgb = 1.15 MOhm, Cgb ~ 4e-9 F
records.conditions: Sample thickness and area are not given, so these capacitances cannot be normalised. Fig. 1a (p. 134) marks 10^4, 100 and 1 Hz on the arcs.

records.claim_ko: 논문의 등가회로는 모두 이상적인 R, C (그리고 L) 로만 되어 있다: 벌크·입계 병렬 RC 의 직렬 (그림 1a, 5a), 블로킹 전극용 벌크 RC + 이중층 C 직렬 (그림 3b), 강유전 LiTaO₃ 의 5소자 회로 (그림 6a), 단일 RC (그림 6b), 페라이트의 병렬 RL 두 쌍 (그림 7a).
records.claim: All of the paper's equivalent circuits use ideal R, C (and L) elements: bulk and grain-boundary parallel RC elements in series (Figs. 1a, 5a), a bulk RC in series with a double-layer capacitor for blocking electrodes (Fig. 3b), a five-element circuit for ferroelectric LiTaO3 (Fig. 6a), a single RC (Fig. 6b) and two parallel RL pairs for a ferrite (Fig. 7a).
records.math: Fig.1a (Rb||Cb)-(Rgb||Cgb);  Fig.3b (Rb||Cb)-Cdl;  Fig.5a (R1||C1)-(R2||C2);  Fig.6b R||C;  Fig.7a (R1||L1)-(R2||L2)
records.conditions: No constant-phase element and no separate series resistance appear; in Fig. 1a the bulk arc starts at the origin.

records.claim_ko: 크기 l₁ 인 정육면체 결정립이 두께 l₂ 인 입계로 나뉜 이상화된 brickwork 모델에서 C_b/C_gb = l₂/l₁ (식 4) 이며, 이는 식 3 의 두께-커패시턴스 반비례에서 나온다.
records.claim: In the idealised brickwork model of cube-shaped grains of size l1 separated by boundaries of thickness l2, Cb/Cgb = l2/l1 (Eq. 4), which follows from the inverse relation between thickness and capacitance in Eq. 3.
records.conditions: Idealised: cubic grains, uniform boundaries and, implicitly through Eq. 3, similar permittivity in grain and boundary. Fig. 2 also labels a gap l3 next to the electrode that the text never defines.

records.claim_ko: 입계 커패시턴스는 보통 10⁻¹¹–10⁻⁸ F 이며, 큰 값은 입계가 얇은 잘 소결된 세라믹, 작은 값은 constriction 저항이나 좁은 neck 으로만 닿은 덜 소결된 시료에서 나온다.
records.claim: Grain-boundary capacitances usually lie between 10^-11 and 10^-8 F: high values occur in well-sintered ceramics with narrow intergranular regions, low values in poorly sintered samples with constriction resistances or narrow contacting necks.

values.label: grain boundary
values.note: empirical ('it is found'); no cell constant stated

records.conditions: 'usually', empirical over 'a wide variety of ceramic microstructures'. In the Fig. 1 example the large Cgb indicates good sintering, yet the boundaries carry 2-3 times the grain resistance (p. 134).

records.claim_ko: 저항의 온도 의존성은 Arrhenius 형식으로 그린다: 그림 1b 는 벌크와 입계를 따로 log₁₀(σT) (ohm⁻¹ cm⁻¹ K) 대 1000/T 로, LiTaO₃ 자료는 log R 대 1000/T 로 그린다.
records.claim: The temperature dependence of resistance is plotted in Arrhenius format: Fig. 1b shows log10(sigma*T) (ohm^-1 cm^-1 K) against 1000/T separately for bulk and grain boundary, and the LiTaO3 data are plotted as log R against 1000/T.
records.conditions: The paper prints no activation-energy formula, no Ea values and no sigma = l/(R*A); the sigma*T form is visible only in the Fig. 1b axis label. Linearity is used qualitatively (a leakage or single-RC resistance 'gives a linear Arrhenius plot', pp. 137-138).
records.quote: The temperature dependence of resistance is usually plotted in Arrhenius format, as shown in Figure 1b

records.claim_ko: 그림 1b 에서 벌크와 입계의 Arrhenius 직선은 기울기가 달라 서로 교차하므로, 어느 쪽 기여가 더 큰지가 온도에 따라 바뀐다.
records.claim: In Fig. 1b the bulk and grain-boundary Arrhenius lines have different slopes and cross, so which contribution is larger changes with temperature.

values.label: crossing point
values.note: approximate, read from the figure by us

records.conditions: Read from the figure (the grain-boundary line is the steeper one); the text does not comment on the crossing.
records.quote: b) Temperature dependence of bulk and grain boundary conductivities for Ca₁₂Al₁₄O₃₃.

records.claim_ko: 커패시턴스로 성분을 가르는 것은 보통 쉽지만, 벌크 유전율이 10³–10⁵ 인 강유전 성분이 있으면 예외이고, 그때는 커패시턴스의 온도 의존성으로 강유전 성분과 비강유전 얇은 층을 가른다.
records.claim: Telling components apart by capacitance is usually straightforward unless a ferroelectric component with bulk permittivity 10^3-10^5 is present; then ferroelectric and non-ferroelectric thin-layer capacitances are told apart by their temperature dependence.
records.conditions: Materials with a ferroelectric phase (BaTiO3, LiTaO3 in the paper).

records.claim_ko: Li₂Si₂O₅ 유리의 수화/탄산화 표면층은 벌크 아크(~4 × 10⁻¹² F)와 전극 응답(~1 × 10⁻⁶ F) 사이에 C ~1 × 10⁻⁸ F 의 잘 분리되지 않은 반원을 하나 더 만들고, 표면층이 없는 유리는 벌크 아크와 전극 스파이크(~1 × 10⁻⁵ F)만 보인다.
records.claim: A hydrated/carbonated surface layer on Li2Si2O5 glass shows up as an additional, poorly-resolved semicircle with C ~1 x 10^-8 F between the bulk arc (~4 x 10^-12 F) and the electrode response (~1 x 10^-6 F); the layer-free glass shows only the bulk arc and an electrode spike (~1 x 10^-5 F).
records.where: Sect. 2.2 text; Fig. 3a,b annotations and caption
records.conditions: Numbers are figure annotations (Fig. 3a,b) in absolute F, geometry not given; the layer forms by atmospheric attack while the melt cools.

records.claim_ko: 이온을 막는 금속 전극에서는 저주파 응답이 전극에 전하가 쌓이는 것을 뜻하는 거의 수직인 스파이크(전하이동 없는 순수 용량성 계면)이며, 벌크 RC 와 이중층 커패시턴스의 직렬로 나타낸다.
records.claim: With ion-blocking metal electrodes the low-frequency response is a nearly vertical spike representing charge build-up at the electrodes (a purely capacitive interface, no charge transfer), modelled as the bulk RC in series with a double-layer capacitance.
records.conditions: Ionic conductor with metal electrodes that block the mobile ion.
records.quote: a nearly vertical, low frequency 'spike' representing charge build-up at the blocking metal electrodes

records.claim_ko: 금속 전극을 단 시료가 반원 하나(LiGaSiO₄ 는 2 × 10⁻¹² F)만 보이고 저주파 전극 스파이크가 없으면, 전극에서 전하이동 장벽이 없고 전도 종은 전자라고 결론짓는다.
records.claim: When a sample with metal electrodes shows a single semicircle (2 x 10^-12 F for LiGaSiO4) and no low-frequency electrode spike, there is no barrier to charge transfer at the electrode and the conducting species are electrons.
records.conditions: Metal electrodes that would block ions: ions would pile up (spike), electrons pass freely (no spike).
records.quote: no impedance barrier to charge transfer between the metal electrode and the ceramic and that the conducting species were electrons

records.claim_ko: 온도가 높아지면 벌크 반원이 계측기 주파수 범위 밖으로 나가 고주파 교점(R_b 로 표시)만 보이고, 더 높은 온도에서는 입계 반원도 범위를 벗어난다.
records.claim: At higher temperatures the bulk semicircle lies outside the instrument's frequency range, so only its high-frequency intercept (labelled R_b) is seen; at still higher temperatures the grain-boundary semicircle goes off scale too.
records.math: Fig. 4b (512 degC): Z' intercepts Rb, Rb+Rgb, Rb+Rgb+Rct;  Fig. 4c (1169 degC): Rb+Rgb+Rct only
records.conditions: Happens whenever the bulk relaxation frequency exceeds the top of the sweep. Ca12Al14O33 with partially blocking electrodes.
records.quote: the semicircle corresponding to the bulk impedance is out with respect to the frequency scale of the instrumentation in both (b) and (c)

records.claim_ko: 부분적으로 막는 전극에서 C = 2.2 × 10⁻⁶ F 인 작고 잘 분리되지 않은 반원은 전극-세라믹 계면의 전자 이동으로 배정되며, 여기서 전하이동 저항을 구할 수 있다.
records.claim: With a partially blocking electrode, a small, poorly resolved semicircle with C = 2.2 x 10^-6 F is assigned to electron transfer at the electrode-ceramic interface, from which a charge-transfer resistance can be determined.

values.label: charge transfer, electrode-ceramic interface
values.note: Ca12Al14O33 at 512 degC; electrode area not given

records.conditions: Oxide-ion conductor with metal electrodes; absolute F.

records.claim_ko: 45° 로 기운 저주파 스파이크는 확산에 해당하고, 그것이 반원 모양으로 꺾여 내려오면 유한 두께 층을 통한 확산이다.
records.claim: A low-frequency spike inclined at 45 degrees is associated with diffusion, and when it turns over into a semicircle the diffusion is through a layer of finite thickness.
records.conditions: Oxygen diffusion through the electrode in the paper's example; the turn-over appears at higher temperature (Fig. 4c) when charge transfer becomes negligible.
records.quote: the inclined spike turns over in the form of a semicircle, indicating that the diffusion is through a layer of finite thickness.

records.claim_ko: 복소 전기 모듈러스는 M* = jωC₀Z* (C₀ = e₀·A/l) 이며, 임피던스 평면에 아크가 하나만 보여도 이 형식으로 보면 입계와 벌크 응답이 모두 드러날 수 있다.
records.claim: The complex electric modulus is M* = j*omega*C0*Z* with C0 = e0*A/l, and presenting data in this formalism can reveal both grain-boundary and bulk responses when the impedance plane shows a single arc.
records.math: M* = j*omega*C0*Z*,  C0 = e0*A/l  (Eq. 5);  with Z* = Z' - jZ'':  M' = omega*C0*Z'',  M'' = omega*C0*Z'  (expansion ours)
records.conditions: Needs the sample geometry (A, l); C0 is the empty-cell (vacuum) capacitance.

records.claim_ko: RC 요소의 Z″ 스펙트럼 피크 높이는 R/2 이므로, Z″ 그림은 시료에서 저항이 가장 큰 요소를 두드러지게 보여 준다.
records.claim: The Z'' spectroscopic peak of an RC element has height R/2, so Z'' plots pick out the most resistive elements of the sample.
records.conditions: Ideal parallel RC element whose peak is not overlapped by another element's.

records.claim_ko: 요소의 M″ 스펙트럼 피크 높이는 e₀/2C 이므로, 모듈러스 그림은 커패시턴스가 가장 작은 요소(벌크)를 두드러지게 보여 준다.
records.claim: The M'' spectroscopic peak of an element has height e0/2C, so modulus plots pick out the elements with the smallest capacitance (the bulk).
records.math: M''max = e0/(2C);  with C0 = e0*A/l this is C0/(2C) = e0/(2*C*l/A), so C*l/A = e0/(2*M''max) and eps_r = 1/(2*M''max)  (rearrangement ours)
records.conditions: The paper gives the height, not the position; for one ideal RC element the M'' peak also sits at omega*R*C = 1 (standard result, not printed here). With e0 in F/cm, M'' is dimensionless only if C is per unit cell constant (F/cm) — the nF.cm^-1 axis of Fig. 5c.

records.claim_ko: 입계 저항이 지배하는 거의 이상적인 반원 하나가 벌크 요소를 숨길 수 있으며, 그 벌크는 더 높은 주파수의 두 번째 M″ 피크로 드러난다 — Z″ 그림은 피크 하나, M″ 그림은 둘.
records.claim: A single, nearly ideal impedance-plane semicircle dominated by the grain-boundary resistance can hide a bulk element that appears as a second, higher-frequency M'' peak: the Z'' plot has one peak while the M'' plot has two.
records.conditions: Electrically inhomogeneous material in which the grain-boundary resistance dominates; the only hint in the Z* plane is a slight non-ideality at high frequency.

records.claim_ko: M″ 피크에서 얻은 커패시턴스는 셀 상수로 규격화해 nF·cm⁻¹ 로 그리고(그림 5c), ε′ = C/C₀ 로 유전율로 바꾸며(그림 6c), 1/ε′ 로 Curie–Weiss 그림을 그린다(그림 5d).
records.claim: Capacitances obtained from M'' peaks are reported per unit cell constant in nF.cm^-1 (Fig. 5c) and converted to permittivity as eps' = C/C0 (Fig. 6c), with a Curie-Weiss plot of 1/eps' (Fig. 5d).
records.where: Fig. 5c y-axis label and caption (also Fig. 6c, p. 137)
records.math: C*l/A in F/cm (Fig. 5c axis);  eps_r = C/C0 = C*l/(e0*A)  (Fig. 6c curves labelled C1/C0, C2/C0)

values.label: C1, grain boundary of doped BaTiO3
values.note: approximate, read from Fig. 5c by us; temperature independent

records.conditions: Shown only in figure axes and labels; the text never states the normalisation in words.

records.claim_ko: 비강유전 입계 커패시턴스는 온도에 무관하고 강유전 벌크 커패시턴스는 퀴리 온도로 갈수록 점근적으로 커지므로, 이것으로 둘을 가른다.
records.claim: The non-ferroelectric grain-boundary capacitance is temperature independent, whereas the ferroelectric bulk capacitance rises asymptotically towards the Curie temperature, which separates the two.
records.conditions: Doped BaTiO3 (PTCR). The LiTaO3 lattice-polarisation capacitance is likewise 'essentially temperature independent' away from Tc (p. 137).

records.claim_ko: Li⁺ 를 막는 금 전극을 단 LiTaO₃ 결정에서 직렬 커패시턴스 ~2 × 10⁻⁶ F 는 결정-전극 계면의 이중층이며, 전형적인 이중층 값이라고 한다.
records.claim: For a LiTaO3 crystal with Li+-blocking gold electrodes, a series capacitance of ~2 x 10^-6 F is assigned to the double layer at the crystal-electrode interface and called a typical double-layer value.

values.label: double layer, Au on LiTaO3 (Li+ blocking)

records.conditions: Blocking electrodes; the element is in series with the rest of the circuit (Fig. 6a).

records.claim_ko: 논문의 예에서 비강유전 고체의 벌크 커패시턴스는 10⁻¹² F 급(Ca₁₂Al₁₄O₃₃, LiGaSiO₄, Li₂Si₂O₅ 유리, 비강유전 방향의 LiTaO₃)이고, 강유전 LiTaO₃ 의 격자 분극 커패시턴스는 10⁻¹⁰–10⁻⁹ F 이다.
records.claim: Across the paper's examples, bulk capacitances of non-ferroelectric solids are of order 10^-12 F (Ca12Al14O33, LiGaSiO4, Li2Si2O5 glass, non-ferroelectric LiTaO3), while the lattice-polarisation capacitance of ferroelectric LiTaO3 is 10^-10-10^-9 F.

values.label: LiTaO3, ferroelectric orientation, lattice polarisation C2

records.conditions: Absolute F; sample geometries are not given, so none of these is normalised.
